title: Core Switch Uplink Flapping

resolution: Replaced the SFP+ transceiver and patched the fiber cable; port stability restored.

resolution: Reset the VPN authentication service on the perimeter firewall.

resolution: Technician arrived on-site and performed a hot-swap of the RBC55 battery cartridge.

title: Can't access printer

resolution: Static IP address conflict found; assigned a new reserved IP to the printer via DHCP.

resolution: Identified MTU mismatch on the tunnel interface; adjusted MTU size to 1400 bytes to prevent fragmentation.

title: Wi-Fi is super slow in the cafeteria

resolution: Increased AP power levels and optimized channel selection to mitigate signal interference from the kitchen microwave.

title: Server rack overheating alert

resolution: Building management cleared a debris blockage in the CRAC unit intake; temperatures normalized within an hour.

title: DNS resolution failing for internal resources

resolution: Restarted the DNS Server service and forced a synchronization with the secondary DNS controller.

title: Lost connection to the SAN

resolution: Rebooted the secondary storage controller which had hung due to a firmware memory leak.

title: Office lights are flickering

resolution: Electrical contractor tightened a loose neutral wire in the main circuit breaker panel.

title: Firewall Rule propagation failure

title: Cannot map network drive

resolution: Found that the user's account was inadvertently moved out of the correct AD security group during the last sync; restored group membership.

title: Core Switch Uplink Failure

title: VPN connectivity issues

resolution: Updated the root certificate store and reinstalled the VPN client profile; connectivity restored.

title: UPS Battery Warning
description: APC Smart-UPS 3000 in the server room is reporting 'Battery Replacement Required' on the LCD. Input voltage is stable at 120V, but the unit is beeping intermittently.
resolution: Scheduled maintenance window and replaced the hot-swappable battery cartridge; unit self-test passed.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: My drive M: keeps saying 'Access Denied'. This is very frustrating as I have a deadline. I am running Windows 10 build 22H2.
resolution: Found a stale AD group membership; removed and re-added the user to the appropriate Security Group.

title: Intermittent Wi-Fi drops in Building B
description: Users in the West wing of Building B are complaining about Wi-Fi disconnecting every 20 minutes. AP logs show 'Deauthentication: Reason 4 (Disassociated due to inactivity)'.
resolution: Adjusted channel width and updated firmware on AP-B-WEST-04 to address known radio interference issues.

title: Server disk space alert

resolution: Cleared legacy log files and moved temp installation data to archive storage, freeing up 40GB.

title: DNS resolution failure

resolution: Cleared DNS cache on primary DCs and performed a zone transfer refresh; forwarders reconfigured.

title: Printer queue stuck

title: Office lights are flickering

resolution: Directed ticket to Facilities department; identified as a failing ballast in the overhead fluorescent lighting.

title: SSL Certificate Expiration

resolution: Renewed SSL certificate via DigiCert and deployed the new PFX file to the load balancer.

title: External site blocked

resolution: Verified site reputation and added the FQDN to the firewall bypass list for the marketing department VLAN.

title: UPS Battery Fault Alert

resolution: Scheduled a maintenance window to swap out the aging battery cartridge; system diagnostics now pass all integrity checks.

title: I can't reach the fileshare
description: Hey, the server \\FS-PROD-01 is totally unreachable. I'm getting a timeout error when I try to map the drive. I've restarted my laptop but it didn't help.
resolution: Reset the SMB service on the file server and cleared stale TCP connections from the firewall state table.

title: Latency spikes in VLAN 20
description: Users in the Finance department are reporting intermittent lag when accessing cloud-based ERP systems. Traceroutes show latency spikes originating at the Distribution Layer switch (DIST-SW-02). CPU utilization on the switch backplane is fluctuating between 85-95%.

title: Guest Wi-Fi is down

resolution: Restarted the WLC authentication service which had stopped responding; guest portal is now successfully issuing tokens.

resolution: Hot-swapped the failed 4TB WD Purple drive; RAID array is currently rebuilding successfully.

title: DNS resolution issues
description: Some internal hostnames are not resolving. I tried flushing the cache, but nslookup just times out. It seems random, sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn't.
resolution: Updated the forwarders on the primary DC; cleaned up a loop in the secondary DNS recursive lookup configuration.

title: Help! Server room smells like ozone

title: Printer queue stalled

resolution: Cleared the spooler directory on the print server and updated the driver to the latest V4 PCL6 version.

title: Core Switch Uplink Flapping
description: We are seeing intermittent connectivity loss on the primary stack in IDF-04. The core switch logs show 'ERR_DISABLE' status on port Gi1/0/48, which is the uplink to the distribution layer. This is causing network drops for the entire marketing floor every 15 minutes.
resolution: Replaced faulty SFP+ transceiver and patched the fiber uplink, stability confirmed.

title: UPS Battery Warning
description: The APC Smart-UPS in the server room is chirping and the front panel displays 'Replace Battery'. I'm worried about an unexpected shutdown during a power fluctuation. Can we get this serviced before it fails entirely?
resolution: Scheduled maintenance window to replace the battery cartridge while on bypass mode.

title: Cannot access VCenter
description: I keep getting a 503 Service Unavailable error when trying to access the vSphere client. I’ve checked the ESXi hosts and they seem to be running fine, but I can't manage my VMs. Help.

title: Slow VPN speeds
description: It's super slow today. My RDP session to the file server keeps lagging out. Is the firewall saturated? I'm on Windows 11 and using the latest Cisco AnyConnect client.
resolution: Identified high bandwidth utilization from a backup job; rescheduled backup to off-peak hours.

title: NTP Desync on DC01
description: Monitoring alerts are flagging a clock skew of over 500ms on our primary Domain Controller. This is triggering Kerberos authentication failures across the forest. Please investigate the external time source connectivity.
resolution: Updated W32Time configuration to point to internal stratum 1 NTP servers and forced a resync.

title: DHCP Scope Exhausted
description: Users in the Guest Wi-Fi VLAN are unable to get an IP address. I checked the DHCP server and the scope for 192.168.50.x is full. Seems like the lease time is too long.
resolution: Cleared inactive leases and reduced DHCP lease duration from 8 days to 4 hours.

title: Rack A-02 Power Outage
description: Everything in Rack A-02 is dead. The PDU displays a 0A load. I suspect the breaker tripped in the facility room.
resolution: Reset the tripped circuit breaker in the PDU and load-balanced hardware to prevent recurrence.

title: Printer Queue Issues

resolution: Removed corrupted print driver and performed a clean install of the manufacturer's V4 universal print driver.

title: Firewall Rule Request
description: Hi team, we need port 8443 opened between the app server and the database segment for the new project. Can you handle this?
resolution: Added the requested ACL to the edge firewall and verified connectivity via telnet.

title: Disk Latency on SAN
description: VMs hosted on LUN_03 are experiencing extreme latency during peak hours. The storage array dashboard indicates IOPS are hitting the ceiling. We need to move some workloads.
resolution: Migrated high-IOPS database VMs to the SSD-tier storage pool to alleviate bottleneck.

title: DNS resolution failing
description: I can ping 8.8.8.8 but I can't reach any websites by name. I flushed the local cache, but it's still not working. Seems like our DNS servers are down.
resolution: Resolved DNS forwarder configuration error caused by a recent ISP upstream server change.

title: Unauthorized Device Alert
description: The NAC system just blocked a device on port 24. MAC address is 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E. It's trying to access the production network.
resolution: Investigated the device and confirmed it was a personal laptop; moved the port to the restricted VLAN.

resolution: Reset the physical transceiver module and re-seated the fiber patch cable, clearing the interface error counters.

title: UPS battery fault
description: My UPS unit in the server room is beeping incessantly. The LCD panel is flashing an 'Error 05 - Battery Replace' code. Can someone please check this before it shuts down the rack?
resolution: Replaced the depleted lead-acid battery cartridge and performed a successful self-test.

title: VPN gateway timeout
description: I'm having trouble connecting to the office via Cisco AnyConnect on Windows 11. It gets stuck at 40% and eventually says 'Connection Timed Out'. My home internet is fine.
resolution: Increased the session timeout threshold on the head-end firewall and cleared stale VPN sessions for the user ID.

title: Warehouse Wi-Fi dead zones
description: The scanners in the back of the warehouse are constantly dropping off the network. I think we need more access points back there because it's impossible to track inventory right now.
resolution: Performed an RF site survey and adjusted the transmit power on AP-WH-04 and AP-WH-05 to reduce channel overlap.

title: Server room cooling alarm
description: The HVAC sensor in the server closet is reading 88 degrees Fahrenheit. I don't hear the blower running. Please fix this before my servers melt.
resolution: Dispatched facilities team to reset the tripped breaker on the dedicated cooling unit; temperature returned to 68 degrees within 30 minutes.

title: DHCP Scope Exhaustion
description: Devices on the Guest Wi-Fi are failing to pull an IP address. Logs show a 'No more addresses available' error in the DHCP server scope 10.50.20.x.
resolution: Expanded the DHCP scope range and reduced the lease time from 8 days to 4 hours to reclaim stale entries.

title: Fiber link degradation
description: Monitoring tools are alerting on high latency between the main office and the remote branch. The link is showing intermittent packet loss around 5%.
resolution: Identified a bent fiber patch cord at the cross-connect panel and replaced it with a new OM4 LC-LC cable.

title: Backup server storage full
description: The Veeam backup server is reporting that the local repository is full. We haven't had a successful incremental backup in three days.
resolution: Purged backups older than the 30-day retention policy and resized the VMDK virtual disk to accommodate growth.

title: Printer connectivity issues
description: The MFP in accounting stopped printing again. It says 'Network Error' on the screen. Help.
resolution: Assigned a static IP reservation in the DHCP server to prevent the printer from losing its address after a power cycle.

title: Domain Controller NTP sync
description: We are seeing a massive drift in time synchronization across the domain. Server DC01 is 5 minutes ahead of the PDC emulator, causing Kerberos authentication failures.
resolution: Reconfigured the PDC to sync with an external stratum-1 NTP source and forced a w32tm /resync on all DCs.

title: DNS resolution latency
description: DNS queries are taking up to 2 seconds to resolve. This is making everything feel extremely sluggish. Is our forwarder down?
resolution: Removed a dead DNS forwarder entry and pointed the DNS servers to a more responsive public DNS resolver.

title: SSL Certificate expiration
description: Our website is showing a security warning to all clients. The certificate expired yesterday. We need to renew this immediately.
resolution: Renewed the wildcard certificate via our CA and updated the binding on the IIS web server.

title: Core Switch-01 Port Flapping
description: Port Gi1/0/24 on Core Switch-01 is showing intermittent link state changes. Logs indicate high CRC error rates and input drops every 15 minutes. This is causing micro-outages for the entire accounting subnet.
resolution: Replaced the damaged Cat6a patch cable and cleared interface statistics; link stability verified.

description: Hey, I'm trying to connect to the office VPN using the Cisco AnyConnect client on Windows 11, but it keeps throwing error 442. I've restarted my laptop twice and checked my home Wi-Fi, but nothing works. Please fix this, I have a deadline.
resolution: Updated the Cisco AnyConnect client to the latest version and re-registered the virtual miniport adapter.

title: Printer connectivity issues

resolution: Force-synced the DC time with the external NTP pool and increased the tolerance threshold for skew.

description: I tried to push a new policy to the Palo Alto PA-5220, but it failed with an 'Invalid Object Reference' error. Now the commit is stuck at 70%. Need to ensure production traffic isn't impacted.
